title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 083 ]

blocks.text: When I meet with my high school friends once a month, we talk about the good times that we had when we were young or go to the singing room.
We surprise each other sometimes when we realize we are all getting older.
During these meetings, we also discuss the plan of saving money for our trip abroad together ten years later.
